check_box.label: Offline login screen (show an image instead of the web page)
check_box.name: local_login_splash_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Skip loading the web login page; takes effect the next time the login screen is shown

line_editor.name: splash_image_path
line_editor.tool_tip: Full path to a PNG or JPG to use as the offline login background. Leave empty for the bundled crest.

button.label: Browse
button.name: splash_image_browse
button.tool_tip: Pick an image file for the offline login background

check_box.label: Show logo on the login screen
check_box.name: show_login_logo_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Show or hide the viewer logo next to the login fields

line_editor.name: login_logo_path
line_editor.tool_tip: Full path to a PNG or JPG to replace the stock logo. Leave empty for the stock logo.

button.label: Browse
button.name: login_logo_browse
button.tool_tip: Pick an image file to replace the login screen logo

check_box.label: Don't remind me about optional updates
check_box.name: no_update_reminders_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Suppress optional update prompts. Required updates will still prompt, and automatic installation (if selected in Preferences) still works.

check_box.label: Split long sounds into equal-length parts
check_box.name: long_sound_equal_splits_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Sounds over the clip limit upload as numbered parts. Unchecked: each part is max length with a shorter final part. Checked: all parts are cut to near-equal length.

check_box.label: Normalize perceived loudness of uploads (like Audacity's Loudness Normalization)
check_box.name: normalize_sound_uploads_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Measure each upload's integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770 LUFS) and gain it onto the target before encoding. Long sounds are measured once as a whole so split parts stay level-matched.

slider.name: target_lufs_slider
slider.tool_tip: -23 LUFS matches the EBU R128 / games loudness standard

spinner.name: target_lufs_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: -23 LUFS matches the EBU R128 / games loudness standard

check_box.label: Normalize loudness of downloaded sounds (background, patches playing sounds live)
check_box.name: normalize_downloaded_sounds_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Check downloaded sound assets against the target loudness on the thread pool. Sounds always play immediately; if one needed adjusting, it is hot-swapped mid-playback where it left off and the sound cache is updated. Viewer UI sounds are never processed.
